notes.title: Update on March 16th
notes.content: 1. Added the gameplay of visiting famous ministers.

notes.title: Updated on the evening of March 10th
notes.content:
1. The Endless Tower is open up to the 100th floor.
2. Enriched the skills of the boss of the Endless Tower.
Upcoming release:
Visiting Famous Officials: Seeking Famous Officials to Enhance Strength
Mojia Workshop: Collecting Divine Weapons.

notes.title: Update on March 9th
notes.content:
1. Introduce the Burning Skill System
2. Add 1 academic and 2 characteristic skills around the burning system.

notes.title: Updated on the evening of March 4th
notes.content:
1. Optimize material drop to match the consumption ratio of each material during automatic creation.
2. Add game instructions.
3. Add a name change function.
4. Fix bugs that may cause monsters not to refresh

notes.title: Updated on the evening of March 3rd
notes.content:
1. Increase the auspiciousness of heavenly descent, with a certain probability of doubling or tripling the number of materials dropped during monster fights.
2. Add natural equipment functions to create and drop items. The effect is that all the entry values are full.
3. Fix possible crash bugs.

notes.title: Updated on the evening of March 2nd
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45486768/323052e2e8fa65ab78630bd5590386edcf17414a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45486768/a2389e432e3b695270f3bac33fa00f7b919c52fb.png[/img][/url]1. Expand the size of the equipment preview box and enlarge the font slightly.
2. Change the disassembly button to immediately disassemble the equipment that meets the conditions in the backpack according to the set batch. If you do not want the equipment to be disassembled, you can lock it.
3. Optimized an issue where the game crashes due to a special case of flashing monsters.
4. Fix the bug where the lock flag is not archived

notes.title: Updated on March 2nd
notes.content:
1. Fix a bug where a boss's skill loading error occurred.
2. Added a title upgrade function. Titles will affect the attributes of character upgrades. It should be noted that after upgrading, if the attribute is in battle, the bonus effect will not be immediately displayed. It will only be displayed when the attribute is reloaded, such as when the character dies or switches maps
3. Fix some copywriting errors in the blacksmith shop.
4. Enhance the combat power, vitality, and defense of player character upgrade bonuses, slightly increase the vitality and defense of monster upgrade bonuses, and reduce the combat power of monster upgrade bonuses.
5. Balance the explosion rate ratios of the five materials.
